english.note: Use this when the superficial treatment is cursory or incomplete, such as looking over something quickly.
Use this when “crudely” means roughly or sketchily rather than carefully or in detail.

examples.english: I only looked over the report superficially and haven't yet noticed how many errors it contains.
examples.traditional: 我粗略咁睇過份報告，仲未發現入面有幾多錯。

examples.english: I crudely sketched out the plan once; ask me if you have any questions.
examples.traditional: 我粗略咁講一次個計劃，你有問題再問。
